Out of the Shadows'' |author=[[Justina Ireland]]{{Disney|url=book/out-of-the-shadows|text=Out of the Shadows|subdomain=books}} |cover artist=*[[Ario Anindito]] *[[Grzegorz Krysiński]] |illustrator= |editor= |publisher=[[Disney–Lucasfilm Press]] |early release= |release date=[[July 27]], [[2021]] |intl release= |rereleased= |media type=Hardcover |pages=423 |isbn=9781368060653 |isbn2= |isbn3= |audiobook=[[The High Republic: Out of the Shadows (audiobook)|Audiobook]] |timeline=[[231 BBY]]''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''The High Republic: Out of the Shadows'' to [[231 BBY]]. |series=''[[Star Wars: The High Republic]]'' {{C|Phase I}} |preceded by=[[The High Republic: Into the Dark|''Into the Dark'']] |followed by=[[The High Republic: Midnight Horizon|''Midnight Horizon'']] }} '''''The High Republic: Out of the Shadows''''' is a young-adult novel released on [[July 27]], [[2021]]. It was written by [[Justina Ireland]] and published by [[Disney–Lucasfilm Press]] as part of the ''[[Star Wars: The High Republic]]'' publishing campaign. It was announced at a ''High Republic'' [[Wikipedia:New York Comic Con|New York Comic Con]] panel on [[October 8]], [[2020]]. A preview chapter was published with the novel ''[[The High Republic: Into the Dark]]''.
